geometry_validation.contact_point_convention: Robot-side witness = MuJoCo midpoint minus half the signed gap times the robot outward contact normal.
geometry_validation.extent_review: Retain exact CAD facets as position candidates. Guaranteed seed disk diameters are 0.574 to 3.251 mm; finite pad size and force capacity require separate design and loading measurements.
geometry_validation.contact_sampling_limit: A rejected collision witness does not prove separation of the full patch. Box-face contact records sample a manifold sparsely; force relocation from a corner into a facet requires a separate wrench model.
